description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Winding up of the Finance Company Limited
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the commercial matter of winding up a financial company ("The Finance Company PLC") under court supervision. It involves the appointment of a liquidator and procedures for handling the company's assets and expenses, which falls under business/commercial regulations and corporate dissolution - the core focus of Commercial Gazettes (Type 6). The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land, legal, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
